meaning: to work or study late into the night
literal_translation: trabalhar ou estudar até tarde da noite
example: She burned the midnight oil to finish her thesis before the deadline.
origin: From the time when lamps burned oil, so working late meant using lamp oil at night

wrong_meanings.why_wrong: The idiom describes working late, not spending money on energy.
The idiom is about working or studying hard at night, not about cooking.
The idiom describes the opposite of resting; it means working late.

explanation: 'Burn the midnight oil' means to work or study until very late at night, usually to meet a deadline. It is common in academic and professional contexts.
